# ScramClientTexture

*Client*

A texture by its ID, from `scram.texture(textureId)`, e.g. for [`texture`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent#texture) of a script UI.

## Methods

### getTexture {#gettexture}

::: member

**Returns** `Texture` — the loaded BBS texture, for Java code

:::
